rappel_detail.anchor: old fixed tat on a rock horn, or a slung horn or chockstone
rappel_detail.station: The top of the final snow and rock step above the McAllister Glacier.
rappel_detail.notes: The one rappel, back to the glacier: in one go on a 60 m rope, or as two shorter rappels on a 30 m. Some parties downclimb it when conditions allow.
hazards: Anchors are old tat and natural features; carry spare slings and cord.

set.rappels: One rappel down the final snow and rock step to the McAllister Glacier on a 60 m rope (two shorter on a 30 m), or downclimb it
